{{Dialogue|Weeze|I didn't know we had any ''Jedi'' clients. Vault number and password?|Solo|I don't have either. But you already know that.|Weeze|I ''didn't'' know that. Did you?|Rosii|Kind of thought so. I haven't seen any Jedi in here.|attr=Weeze, Jaina Solo, and Rosii|src=<ref name="Abyss" />}}
'''Rosii''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Galactic Alliance Security]] guard stationed at a [[Galactic Alliance Security Detention Center 81|secret]] [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Valin Horn]] and [[Jysella Horn]] were being held in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. Rosii served alongside GAS [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Weeze]], and both were present when a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] entered the facility with permission from [[Judge/Legends|Judge]] [[Arabelle Lorteli]] to visit the Horns. Rosii and Weeze denied that the psychotic Jedi were there, but a Galactic Alliance Security assault team under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]] were forced to allow the Jedi access to the Horns after they presented the document.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You're not going to make it past the lobby.|Rosii, to Jaina Solo|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
[[File:ValinHorn-G6Sketch.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Valin Horn (pictured) was detained in the blockhouse Rosii was stationed at.]]
The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] Rosii served in [[Galactic Alliance Security]] in the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Abyss" /> In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM}} dates the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. As ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third installment of the series, is dated to 43 ABY by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', its events must take place in 43.5 ABY.</ref> he was stationed as a guard<ref name="Abyss" /> in [[Galactic Alliance Security Detention Center 81]],<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref> a secret [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse|blockhouse]] under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Wruq Retk]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]] and his sister, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Jysella Horn]], both came down with an [[Force psychosis|enigmatic psychosis]],<ref name="Abyss" /> and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|decided]] to [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encase]] them in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref> They were eventually placed in the blockhouse in which Rosii was stationed.<ref name="Abyss" />

The [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] discovered the location of the Horn siblings, however, and obtained a document granting them permission to enter the facility by using a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on [[Arabelle Lorteli]]&mdash;the head [[Judge/Legends|judge]] of the [[Court of Jedi Affairs]]. Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] arrived at the facility and approached Rosii and another Rodian, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Weeze, in the lobby. Solo claimed that they both knew she didn't have a vault number and password and was there for something else, and while Weeze said he hadn't known that, Rosii revealed he had suspected that to be the case and said he hadn't seen any Jedi there. When Solo demanded to see the Horn sibilings, Rosii expressed confusion outwardly while inwardly being alarmed, claiming to only know them as the Jedi who went crazy. As Solo continued, the Rodians denied the fact that the Horns were in the facility, and Weeze raised a silent alarm.<ref name="Abyss" />

Solo quickly used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|push]] them away and dispatch of their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Rosii confidently claimed that Solo would not make it far inside, but quickly became afraid when a group of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] arrived at the facility with a large contingent of the press. Solo presented the document signed by Lorteli to the Rodians again, but at that moment, a Galactic Alliance Security assault [[Squad/Legends|squad]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]] arrived. The Jedi then presented the document to Atar, who was forced to allow them into the facility. When Galactic Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] later arrived, Rosii and Weeze nervously followed behind her.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I came to see Valin and Jysella Horn.''"<br />"Horn''? Aren't those the two Jedi Knights who went barvy?|Jaina Solo and Rosii|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Rosii was skinnier than Weeze, a fellow Rodian whom he worked alongside at a secret Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse. He had a buzzy and nasal voice that Jaina thought sounded stereotypically Rodian.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Skills and abilities==
Rosii and Weeze failed at their attempt to convince Jedi Knight Jaina Solo that the building was merely a storage facility, and could not discharge their blasters before she disarmed them.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Equipment==
Rosii wore a [[Color/Legends|black]] paramilitary [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] with his name tag sewn on it and the [[Writing/Legends|words]] "Galactic Alliance Storage" embroidered in yellow on one of its pockets. He also carried a blaster.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rosii appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'' the third novel in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, which was written by [[Troy Denning]] and published in [[2009]].<ref name="Abyss" />
